title: Google App Campaigns (UAC) Guide
deck: UAC is a black-box campaign where machine learning decides bidding, targeting, and creative combinations. The operator's three levers are (1) campaign structure, (2) bid-stage progression, (3) asset group diversity.
summary: UAC splits into Install campaigns (I) and In-app Action campaigns (II/III). New apps start with I, move to II (tCPA) after securing 30+ installs/day, and graduate to III (tROAS) once revenue signal stabilizes. Safe bid changes: at most once a week, within ±20%.

content.html: UAC learns per campaign, so splitting = splitting the learning. Too granular starves learning volume; too merged adds optimization noise. Baseline split: always separate iOS / Android and country, but bundle similar countries (US+CA, JP+TW, etc.).

items: Phase 1 · tCPI (Day 1–30) — set the initial target CPI at 1.3–1.5× market average (to accelerate learning). After reaching 30+ installs/day, step it down by −10% at a time.
Phase 2 · tCPA (Day 30–60) — designate a Tier-1 in-app event (sign_up, purchase, etc.) as the conversion. Initialize CPA = CPI × (inverse of install→event CVR).
Phase 3 · tROAS (Day 60+) — enter after D7 or D30 revenue stabilizes. Start the ROAS target around LTV/CAC = 1.0 and raise +10% weekly.

content.title: Learning Phase
content.html: After any bid change, the campaign is learning for at least 7 days + 50 conversions. Changing again during that window restarts the ML and craters cost efficiency. Change at most ±20% at a time.
UAC auto-combines assets into ads. Low diversity = weak learning signal. Run 2–3 asset groups per campaign, each enforcing these minimums:

content.title: The campaign never exits the learning phase
content.html: Under 10 conversions/day, learning can't converge. 1) Move the conversion definition one funnel step up (purchase → add_to_cart). 2) Temporarily raise the bid +30%. 3) Merge countries/OS into one campaign — you can re-split after learning completes.

content.title: A tROAS campaign reports 0 revenue
content.html: Check the revenue-sending toggle for the purchase event in Adjust → Google Ads partner. Without a Firebase connection revenue can't flow — switch to Adjust direct-send mode.

content.title: iOS campaign installs report only via SKAN
content.html: This is normal. All iOS 14.5+ users who declined ATT are classified into the SKAN channel; total installs = deterministic + probabilistic + SKAN summed in the Adjust dashboard.
